name: jev-sentinel
description: Checks every tool call, tool output and reply with TypeSafe's Jev model: prompt-injection screening, approval gating and secret scrubbing.

interface.shortDescription: A second opinion on everything the agent does
interface.longDescription: Before a tool call runs, Jev judges whether it is on task and how risky it is, and the plugin asks you or blocks it. Tool output is screened for instructions aimed at AI agents, and finished replies are checked for harmful content and relayed injections. Secrets are scrubbed from everything sent to Jev.
